full_judgment: 42. Mr Munsurul Haque Chowdhury, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of appellant Opu alias Chakma Opu, adopting the above submissions of Mr Abdul Malek and Mr SM Shahjahan adds that none of the people of the vicinity of the place of the occurrence who saw the occurrence was examined. They were purposely withheld. So presumption would be that had they been examined they would not have supported the prosecution case. There is no credible evidence that PW 8 was the clerk of the deceased, that at the time of occurrence he was driving the motor-cycle by which the deceased was going to the Court. PW 25 was an absconding accused of eight murder cases. He is not a witness of credit. Accused Opu alias Chakma Opu had no overt act. His mere presence at the scene does not attract section 34 read with section 302 of the Penal Code. In this regard he refers the case of Aminul Islam vs State 12 MLR 21. So the Court below wrongly convicted him. His conviction is not sustainable.
